subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Which default diagnostics-otel bucket policy should OpenClaw support for existing exported histograms: this narrower run/harness/context policy, the broader all-duration policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098, or neither yet?
rationale: Both open PRs use the supported OTel API, but they choose different scopes and bucket ranges for existing exported metrics, which is an operator-facing compatibility decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Choose one policy after proof
options.body: Require real OTel export proof, then land only the maintainer-selected bucket scope and close or rework the other PR.

options.title: Prefer this narrower scope
options.body: Accept a targeted change for agent run, harness, and context-token histograms while leaving broader duration metrics for a later owner decision.

options.title: Pause both PRs
options.body: Hold both branches until diagnostics owners define a shared bucket policy for OTel and Prometheus-backed dashboards.

recommendation.title: Choose one policy after proof
recommendation.body: Require real OTel export proof, then land only the maintainer-selected bucket scope and close or rework the other PR.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent diagnostics-otel and OpenTelemetry migration history for the affected service/test surface.
